answer: Read endorsements as a graph, not a count. Newcomers arrive after a slow voyage, holding a vouch or two from veterans who stake their standing on it. A farm mints a dense island of young accounts that only vouch each other. Flag such islands: deposits scale with cluster density, and mutual vouches between fresh accounts count only after they age. Trust flows from established roots, so its absence is measurable - the ledge every check stands on. The walnut cracks where the cluster is densest.
